import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        fast_io();
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int test_count = 1;
        for (int case_number = 1; case_number <= test_count; ++case_number) {
            String line = scanner.next();
            apply_transform(line);
        }
    }

    public static void fast_io() {
        System.out.flush();
    }

    public static void apply_transform(String input) {
        boolean at_replaced = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < input.length(); ++i) {
            if (!at_replaced && i + 1 < input.length() && 
                input.charAt(i) == 'a' && input.charAt(i+1) == 't' && 
                i > 0 && i+1 < input.length()-1) {
                System.out.print('@');
                at_replaced = true;
                ++i;
            } else if (i + 2 < input.length() && 
                       input.charAt(i) == 'd' && 
                       input.charAt(i+1) == 'o' && 
                       input.charAt(i+2) == 't' && 
                       i > 0 && i+2 < input.length()-1) {
                System.out.print('.');
                i += 2;
            } else {
                System.out.print(input.charAt(i));
            }
        }
    }
}
